account.aboutDescription: Haraka Property helps tenants and landlords manage leases, rent payments, and communication in one place.
account.termsBody1: Haraka Property's terms of use govern access to and use of the rental management platform, including the tenant mobile app.
account.termsBody2: By using this app, you accept these terms. You can read the full document on our website.
account.privacyBody1: We collect and process personal data needed to run your tenant account: identity, contact details, lease information, payments, and support messages.

account.supportBody: Need help with the app or your account? Contact our team by email. For lease or rent questions, contact your landlord directly.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.heading: Sorry to see you go
deleteAccount.body: Deleting your account removes your app access. Confirm below to continue.
deleteAccount.typeNameLabel: Type your full name ({{name}}) to enable deletion
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Permanent deletion in 30 days. To keep your account, sign in again and tap Cancel deletion before then.
deleteAccount.infoAccess: You lose access to the tenant app after the 30-day grace period.
deleteAccount.infoLandlord: Leases, invoices, and payments stay with your landlord and may be anonymized.
deleteAccount.infoGrace: You have 30 days to change your mind before deletion becomes permanent.
deleteAccount.infoRecover: To cancel, sign in again during the grace period and tap Cancel deletion on this screen. Signing in alone does not cancel it.
deleteAccount.pendingBody: Your account will be permanently deleted on {{date}} (in {{days}} days). Cancel below to keep your access.
deleteAccount.cancelledBody: Your account deletion was cancelled. You can continue using the app.
deleteAccount.endpointUnavailable: Account deletion is not available on this server yet. Point the app at your local API, or deploy the latest web-manager.
